table.retrieve:
SELECT	
	item.name ,
	item.saleprice ,
	item.icode,
	item.Packcode, 
	item.SalePrice,
	item.PurPrice, 
	item.SaleDiscPerc,
	item.MaxSaleDiscPerc,
	item.PurDiscPerc, 
	item.ReorderQty, 
	item.OptimumQty, 
	item.PackUnits, 
	item.Active ,
	item.Prescribed ,
	item.icatcode,
	item.Refrigrated ,
	item.saleprice2,
	item.saleprice3,
	item.Printable ,
	item.iccode,
	item.RetailPrice,
	item.Taxable,
	item.packSalestax,
	item.GSTPerc1,
	item.GSTPerc2,
	item.printexpiry,
	item.packcode,
	item.manfcode,
	item.usercode,
	item.lastupdate,
	item.packingcost,
	item.minqty,
	item.greorderqty,
	item.goptimumqty,
	item.saleprice4,
	item.saleprice5,
	item.alternatepurprice,
	item.minsaleprice,
	item.purflatdisc,
	item.itemalertcode,
	item.SalesTaxScheduleCode,
	item.PCTCode,
	item.RedemptionDiscPerc,
	SaleRetail=item.saleprice,
	Item.AvgPrice,
	Item.SalePriceChangeMargin,
	Item.UpperSaleQtyLimit,
	Item.ChangeReason,
	Item.Module

FROM 
	item ,
	itemcategory     
WHERE 
	( itemcategory.icatcode = item.icatcode ) and          
	( item.icatcode = :ar_icatcode ) AND 
	( item.Active=1 )

objects.name: item_margin
objects.expression: (( (item_saleprice / IF(item_packunits > 0, item_packunits ,1) ) - item_avgprice ) / if((item_saleprice / IF(item_packunits > 0, item_packunits ,1) )=0,1,(item_saleprice / IF(item_packunits > 0, item_packunits ,1) )) ) * 100
